title: Personal Checking: wire transfer and official check fees by tier
content:
## Scope

This schedule lists the Personal Checking fees for moving money by wire and for buying an official (cashier's) check drawn on the account.

## Fees by tier

| Tier | Outgoing domestic wire, per transfer (USD) | Outgoing international wire, per transfer (USD) | Incoming wire credited to the account, per transfer (USD) | Official (cashier's) check purchased from the account, per check (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Student Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Interest Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Premier Checking | 20.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 10.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Is the fee for an incoming wire the same on every tier?**
A: No. Access, Student, Everyday and Interest Checking show 15.00 USD per incoming wire; Premier Checking and Private Client Checking show 0.00.

**Q: How do the outgoing wire fees step down across the tiers?**
A: The first four tiers share 30.00 USD domestic and 50.00 USD international. Premier Checking is lower at 20.00 and 40.00, and Private Client Checking is lowest at 10.00 and 25.00.

**Hypothetical comparison**: an owner sends one domestic wire and one international wire in the same month. On Everyday Checking the two fees listed are 30.00 and 50.00 USD, a total of 80.00 USD; on Private Client Checking they are 10.00 and 25.00 USD, a total of 35.00 USD.
